notes:
T522 (impression-or-waiver at close, D-b / G6). Instrumentation, not an epistemic claim row — claims: [], new_rows: [].

WHAT LANDED — `managent done` now demands a model impression or an explicit waiver at every close, so model-perf cannot lapse silently (fleet-and-model-audit §3: three orchestrators lapsed identically; the only automated writer was dispatch_verify.record_perf).

GATE CONTRACT (src/managent/main.zig cmdDone):
- `--impression <text>` records how the model performed on this task type; `--impression-waiver <reason>` records the explicit reason no impression is owed.
- Exactly one non-empty field closes the row; both-empty, both-present, and empty impression are all refused. No `--force` bypass (an escape valve is the lapse reborn — the absorption gate's lesson).
- Recorded on the task row as `impression` / `impression_waiver` (new TaskState fields, serialized + parsed + freed + surfaced in `show` and `status --json`), so `close_completeness` (measurement-methodology §6) is derivable from the ledger.
- `revertAcceptanceFailure` restores the fields on a phase-2 acceptance rollback; `reopen` clears them (a reopened row owes a fresh impression, never a stale carry-over).
- `reap --close` (the other close path, orphan→abandoned) now records `impression_waiver = "reaped orphan: <evidence> (no impression — console died before close)"` — a close is a close, and an orphan's N/A is recorded, not silent.

DOWNSTREAM FIXES the new mandatory gate made necessary:
- bin/subagent prompt template (the 'WHEN DONE' done line) now carries `--impression <one line> (or --impression-waiver <reason> ...)` so dispatched workers are not handed a stale close recipe.
- 11 regression scripts that invoke `managent done` were updated with `--impression "... control"` so each still exercises the gate it was built to test (not the new impression refusal): absorption-machinery (D1–D9), claim-lifecycle, directive-integrity, duplicate-dispatch, done-git, done-two-phase, integrity, orient, duty, T227. `duty ... done` and direct-store seeds are unaffected.
- docs/infra/managent/spec.md `done` section documents the gate and the new flags.

CONTROLS (tools/regression-managent-impression-gate.sh, wired into zig build test):
- S1 seeded: neither flag → refused, names both flags, store unmutated. S2 seeded: both flags → refused (ambiguous). S3 seeded: empty --impression "" → refused. N1 null: --impression closes and records the field (waiver left null). N2 null: --impression-waiver closes and records the reason. N3 null: blocked close with a waiver passes (the gate is per-close; a stall is a model datum).
- bin/subagent prompt regression gains 4b: the done line carries both --impression and --impression-waiver.

TEST-FIRST STATUS: not test-first. The gate was implemented, then the regression added and shown green; the seeded arms assert the invariant (refusal + store-unmutated) rather than re-running the pre-T522 binary to observe RED — per the standing rule, the invariant is asserted instead of re-introducing the defect. All 13 affected regressions pass: impression-gate, absorption-machinery, done-git, done-two-phase, integrity, claim-lifecycle, duplicate-dispatch, T227, directive-integrity, duty, orient, subagent-prompt (with WEIZIGO_AGENT_DEPTH unset — at depth 3 the depth-cap refusal masks one label-validation arm), ollama-dispatcher.
